abilities.name: Loot Glint
abilities.description: After a fight, you can see a faint glint on the one dropped item worth the most to you.
abilities.cost: The glint fades if you wait more than a minute

growth.grows: how many items it marks and how far away

abilities.name: Status Peek
abilities.description: Stare at a monster for three seconds to read its level and one weakness from a flickering window.

growth.grows: how much of the window you can read and how strong a target

abilities.name: Quiet Footing
abilities.description: Walk through rubble and broken glass without a sound for as long as you hold your breath.
abilities.cost: Run out of breath and every step afterward is loud

abilities.name: Scavenger's Fix
abilities.description: You can use junk parts to repair a broken tool or weapon well enough to last one more fight.
abilities.cost: Needs real scrap; the repair always breaks after

growth.grows: how badly broken and how many fights it lasts

abilities.name: Danger Ping
abilities.description: Sense a short warning tone when a monster above your level comes within a block.
abilities.cost: The tone is loud only to you; it gives no direction

growth.grows: how far ahead and whether it gives a direction

abilities.name: Overcharge Strike
abilities.description: Channel your stamina into one strike that hits twice as hard, then leaves you winded.
abilities.cost: Winded for a full minute after

abilities.name: Safe Zone Marker
abilities.description: Draw a chalk ring around a small room and weak monsters will not enter it until dawn.
abilities.cost: Chalk runs out; a strong monster ignores the ring and is angered by it

growth.grows: how large the ring and how strong a monster it stops

abilities.name: Ration Stretch
abilities.description: Eat half a ration and you can keep going as if you ate a full one, until the next meal.
abilities.cost: Hunger hits twice as hard at the next meal

abilities.name: Party Link
abilities.description: Touch a teammate's shoulder and sense their health and direction for the next hour.
abilities.cost: You feel a fraction of every wound they take

growth.grows: how many teammates and how far

abilities.name: Monster Lore Drop
abilities.description: Kill a new kind of monster and you can recall one fact about its kind from the system's notes.
abilities.cost: Only on the first kill of each kind

growth.grows: how many facts each kill gives

abilities.name: Second Wind Window
abilities.description: When your health drops below a quarter, a window offers one full breath of strength to escape.
abilities.cost: Once a day; you collapse when the escape is over

growth.grows: how much strength the breath gives

abilities.name: Barricade Instinct
abilities.description: Look at a room and know the fastest way to block its doors with what is inside, in under a minute.
abilities.cost: Only rooms you can see all of
